component.name: MangoHud FPS Switch
component.summary: Switch MangoHud's FPS limit with profiles, also while a game is running

description.p: Keeps FPS profiles like Unlimited, 45, 60 or 90 FPS and sets MangoHud's FPS limit to one of them with a click in the tray. A running game picks up the change right away, no restart needed. An independent tool for MangoHud, not part of the MangoHud project.

ul.li: Profiles in the tray menu; the active one is marked
Add, edit and order profiles, optionally with more MangoHud settings
Starts with the desktop in the tray if you like
Works together with the mangohud-fps-switch command for keyboard shortcuts

description.p: First release of the desktop app: profiles in a window and in the tray, starting with the desktop.
